  AP-1, AP-2, AP-3, AP-4
  ! 5 GHz: AP-3 and AP-4: no reading in either direction (AP-4: not sighted; AP-3: not sighted)

  4 pending setting change(s) (4 transmit power) and 5 failed WLAN check(s). After applying changes,
    run the tool again.
  Partial result (band empty); the exit code says so.

  Scope note: this tool works from UniFi controller configuration and AP-to-AP neighbour scans. It
    cannot see non-WiFi RF interference (BLE/Zigbee/microwave -- needs a spectrum analyzer),
    per-client MCS or retry statistics, real client roaming timing, or packet captures. Neighbour
    RSSI is an AP-to-AP beacon reading; client thresholds are converted to the uplink the controller
    evaluates with a typical client power (`rf.client_tx_dbm`), so a client with a weaker radio is
    still worse off than the corridor suggests. Recommendations are static-analysis heuristics, not
    runtime KPIs.
